ModMetaData.name: EdB Prepare Carefully
ModMetaData.author: EdB
ModMetaData.description:
Local fix of EdB Prepare Carefully.
Original by EdB (edbmods). Workshop: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=735106432 Source: https://github.com/edbmods/EdBPrepareCarefully License: MIT.
Randomize rolls skin color and the genes that drive hair color, skin, hair, beard, head, and body. Preset relationships keep each colonist as a separate person.
Disable the Workshop copy (EdB.PrepareCarefully) while this one is active. Presets saved by the Workshop copy stored one id for every colonist, so those old relationships cannot be recovered. Set them again and save a new preset.
